memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: “He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says.” - Revelation 2:7

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
As we step into 2026, a new year has begun not just to run, but to hear. From above, there is a fresh rush of blessings waiting, but blessings are often released to those who listen carefully. Our faith, obedience, grace, and spirituality are not far away; they are at hand to grow. Yet growth begins when we give attention to the voice of God.
The Lord still says, “Sit and hear; I am the Lord your God.”
In a world full of noise, speed, and endless schedules, God invites us to pause. Too often we go here and there without stopping, busy but not attentive, active but not aligned. This year, let us choose listening over rushing, hearing over hurrying.
When we hear God: Faith becomes firm,
Obedience becomes joyful, Grace becomes sufficient, Spiritual life becomes fruitful

May this year not just give you new opportunities, but a new ear, an ear tuned to heaven. May your homes, churches, and personal lives be marked not by noise, but by clarity from God’s voice.

Give God more time to speak than the world gets to distract.Those who hear Him well will walk wisely in 2026.
“He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says.” Happy New Year 2026 ,  a year to hear, live, and grow.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “God speaks to those who take time to be quiet before Him.” — A. W. Tozer

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Lord, quiet my heart and sharpen my ear. Help me to hear Your voice above every other sound. Lead me clearly in this new year. Father God, grant us ears that hear and hearts that obey.
Let this year be guided by Your voice alone.
In Jesus name, Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: Don’t rush into 2026, listen your way into it.
Those who hear God well will walk wisely all year long.
